node_definition.done_when: At the committed head, tests/test_a_brief_points_rather_than_quotes.py::test_a_report_changes_no_other_dry_run_field passes, and it fails at the base revision in a recorded log. Two dry runs differing only in the done-when overlap produce identical output in every other field, under routing.picker shadow and under routing.picker route alike. A dry run in shadow mode does not call the picker at all. In route mode, the selection's per-call measurements (latency, observation times) are not part of the fields the report compares, while the selected action and backend still appear. A new test in tests/test_routing_picker_key.py pins both modes with the picker stubbed. The gate is tests/test_a_brief_points_rather_than_quotes.py, tests/test_routing_picker_key.py, tests/test_picker_in_dispatch.py and every test file under tests/ that imports reckon/crew/dispatch.py and calls a dry run (found by grep for dry_run), at base and head, with zero added failure ids.
